name: Agent Inbox
description: Messages to your agent on Telegram, Slack or email reach OpenClaw within seconds, and OpenClaw answers in the same conversation. Its tools ask the people in a conversation, ask the operator and bring the answer back to the chat, write to the operator's contacts, read the conversations, and resolve them.

agentinbox.label: Agent Inbox
agentinbox.description: The agent `openclaw agentinbox setup` connected: messages from the operator, and from the contacts it listens to, start OpenClaw.

enabled.description: Listen for messages. On by default once setup connected an agent.

secretKey.description: The agent's Agent Inbox key. `openclaw agentinbox setup` writes it.

agent.description: Which agent the key acts as, by its API name. Set by setup.

apiUrl.description: Agent Inbox's API, when it isn't https://www.agentinbox.md/api.

contactsCanUse.description: What OpenClaw may use in a contact's conversation besides talking with them: tools and tool groups (group:web), MCP servers by name, and agentinbox for this plugin's tools. Nothing by default.

cliCommands.name: agentinbox
cliCommands.description: Agent Inbox: `setup` connects this OpenClaw with a one-time code, `status` shows where it listens
